scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
